svg.text: F-B SÄULE — one ram, a revolver of dies, and gravity
A vertical ram pushes food through whichever die the revolver presents; a blade under the die sets the third cut. Food only falls.
Zone F in the column ≈ 0.25 m², all washed in place
SIDE SECTION, 0.8 px per mm (ram drive above z 1250 drawn shortened)
(or the pot) on a load cell
ram pushes through the 10 mm grid:
the grid itself holds the sticks
heel pushed out by a follower (S8)
right half: in the wash box
Grid as fixture (S6): the cut is chosen by the die

g.text: cuts 1 and 2: the grid
cut 3: blade flush under
the grid every p mm
the grid holds the sticks
while they are cut: no
workholding at all
staggered blades (S7):
4 heights → force ÷ 3–4
edge ≈ 2 × section / pitch;
Ø130 celeriac first
through the 8-wedge die

svg.text: Same column, ten jobs — washed on the other half

g.text: One press axis, ten jobs: dicer, slicer, fries, wedges, ricer,
Spätzle press, patty former (Ø70), stuffing nozzle (Ø40),
iris peeler for carrots, citrus cone, meat flattener.
Cleaning in place, while the next die works:
• die and rotor: back half of the revolver in a 3 L wash box,
spray both faces 55 °C, rinse 85 °C, hot air; rotor spins dry 1 500 rpm
• sleeve: turret turns it between a nozzle above and one below
(straight-through flow, no shadow)
• pusher: retracts into the wash collar · funnel: two fixed nozzles
• heel left in the grid: pushed through by a follower first
• bowl, cradle, trays: to the wash chamber
Weak point: only what fits a Ø140 tube and falls; sheets, Rouladen
and big roasts need a second small machine beside it.

svg.text: 1/7 Box tilter singulates two potatoes down the chute into the sleeve
2/7 Revolver turns: the 10 mm grid comes under the ram; the used die goes into the wash box
3/7 Ram pushes the potatoes through the grid; the face rotor cuts flush under it — dice fall into the bowl
4/7 The heel left in the grid is pushed through by a follower
5/7 Pusher retracts into the wash collar: a nozzle ring rinses it
6/7 Revolver turns again: the used grid is sprayed on both faces, rinsed at 85 °C and dried while the next die works
7/7 Food only ever moved down; nothing travelled to a dishwasher
